content.short: Gensyn is a decentralized AI compute protocol that connects GPU providers with researchers training ML models.
content.description:
Gensyn is a Layer-1 blockchain protocol creating a global, trustless marketplace for machine learning compute. By connecting providers of spare hardware with developers training AI models, Gensyn democratizes access to high-performance computing. The network uses a unique verification layer to ensure computations are performed correctly and efficiently.

The project leverages a probabilistic verification system and graph-based proofs to maintain integrity without redundant work. This approach offers a scalable, cost-effective alternative to centralized providers. Gensyn empowers researchers to build advanced machine learning applications.
